Palette: bone ivory, ash grey, deep violet, ghost-fire purple, pale lilac, black. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no blur, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, eerie shaman spirit magic. NOT anime, no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no letters, no text, no character, no person, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side.
kit-spirit-arrow.action: The arrow flies forward, its purple ghost-fire flickering and the spirit wisps streaming behind, in a loop. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
